platform_constraint_evidence: GitHub Actions workflow uses ubuntu-latest runner exclusively. No Windows-specific dependencies or MSVC requirements found. No macOS-specific frameworks or Xcode project files. Rust/Cargo is cross-platform and works on Linux. CI workflow uses amd64/rust container image.
notes: Repository is a Rust workspace containing Apache Arrow and Parquet implementations. Fix is in parquet crate's column reader module. Project uses cargo as package manager with both Rust unit tests and optional Python integration tests. Platform is fully compatible with Linux x86-64 containers.
